ff1e1db770307f2a3641ab054e25b44fa4cffca1.source:
def render_snapshot_batch(self, snapshots, sources):
        days = []
        dates = self.context.get("dates") or [self.context["date"]]
        for date_str in dates:
            payload = snapshots.get(date_str)
            if payload:
                results = self.add_direct_results(payload.get("results", []), date_str)
                age = cache_age_label(payload.get("generated_at"))
                source = f"{sources.get(date_str, 'Cache')} - updated {age}"
            else:
                results = self.add_direct_results([], date_str)
                source = "Cache unavailable for this date"
            days.append({"date": date_str, "results": results, "source": source, "available": bool(payload)})
        available = sum(bool(day["available"]) for day in days)
        self.render_multi_results(days, f"{available} of {len(days)} dates loaded")
        self.header_status.setText(f"SHARED CACHE / {available} OF {len(days)} DAYS")

source_duplicate_audit.PR16_distinction: PR16 adds unchecked-date wording and loaded-day totals within render_multi_results. A partially loaded batch still creates selected static direct results for missing days and deduplicates official cards across the range, but cache_finished does not enter batch rendering when combined is empty. Calling that renderer blindly with zero loaded dates would replace useful unavailable/retry guidance with a zero-matching summary; this is not the intended repair.

source_duplicate_audit.narrow_scope_advice: Retain the all-missing unavailable status/header and retry guidance. Render only submitted selected direct-provider course links once per range, from configuration, with no date-specific availability claim or fabricated provider rows. Existing add_direct_results([]) uses submitted self.context, supplies no date to direct_result, and therefore avoids weather fetches; preserve that no-network construction. Keep single-date live fallback, pending-search guards, loaded/mixed batch behavior and cache/save lifecycle unchanged. Use integrated-only, direct-only, mixed/deduplicated, changed-pending-controls and intercepted URL regressions.
